novelty_basis: Pascal's triangle for additive CA is classical (Martin, Odlyzko, Wolfram, Comm. Math. Phys. 93 (1984)); automata of the form c'_i = c_i * c_{i+1} over groupoids, groups and quasigroups were studied by J. Pedersen (Complex Systems 6 (1992) 237-250) and C. Moore (Moore-Drisko 1995/96; Moore-Pnin, arXiv:patt-sol/9701008), where the word structure of semigroup and group rules is used. The width bound is immediate.

statement:
For an associative magma the t-step local map is the ordered product F_t(x_0..x_t) = prod_{j < 2^t} x_{s(j)},
s(j) the binary digit sum of j; for a commutative semigroup F_t = prod_k x_k^C(t,k), and the forward and
backward streaming widths of F_t are at most |S|.
title: Light cones of semigroups - the popcount word, Pascal exponents, bounded streaming width
